boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study environments on Tufts’ Medford campus, spanning silent work, reservable group rooms, research computing, and creative production.

cards.title: Hirsh Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Level 2, Room 225
cards.notes: Bring work that benefits from a silent setting; Tisch identifies this room as the Level 2 exception to its otherwise collaborative study zones.
cards.short_summary: A named silent-study room within Tisch’s main-level study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch designates the Hirsh Reading Room on floor 2, room 225, for silent study.
cards.source_title: Studying in the library | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Tisch Library; follow the library’s current building access and hours guidance.

cards.entity_name: Tisch Library Ground (G) Level Study Area
cards.title: Tisch Library Ground (G) Level
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Ground Level
cards.notes: Set up at a table or carrel on the G Level when you need a silent zone and room to spread out with individual or group materials.
cards.short_summary: Ground-level tables and carrels in Tisch’s silent-study zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch’s G Level has study tables and carrels for group and individual work, and the library identifies Level G as silent study.
cards.source_title: Top Five Underutilized Library Study Spaces for Finals | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Use silent-zone norms: the library defines silent study as minimal to no speaking.

cards.entity_name: Study Carrels Along the Purple Wall
cards.title: Study Carrels Along the Purple Wall
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Level 1 perimeter of the stacks
cards.notes: Choose one of the L-shaped carrels along the stack perimeter for individual work; the official guide describes this Level 1 area as quiet.
cards.short_summary: A named L-shaped row of individual carrels by Tisch’s stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch documents an L-shaped row of study carrels against the purple wall on Level 1 along the perimeter of the stacks.
cards.source_title: Top Five Underutilized Library Study Spaces for Finals | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Level 1 is a quiet-study zone; keep conversation hushed and limited.

cards.title: Level 1 Study Tables and Carrels
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Level 1 overlooking Professors Row
cards.notes: Use the Level 1 tables and carrels near the windows for solo reading or a small work session, with Professors Row visible outside.
cards.short_summary: Window-side tables and carrels on Tisch’s quiet Level 1.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch documents Level 1 study tables and carrels near large windows overlooking Professors Row for individual or group study.
cards.source_title: Top Five Underutilized Library Study Spaces for Finals | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Located near the StAAR Writing and Academic Coaching Center; follow quiet-study expectations.

cards.title: Tisch Group Study Room 105
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Reserve Room 105 through Reserve Tufts before meeting with a group, and plan around the one-hour minimum and three-hour daily student limit.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Level 1 room for focused group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch lists Room 105 as a bookable Level 1 group study room and states reservations are limited to three hours per student per day.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Reserve Tufts with a Tufts username and password; rooms are collaborative spaces.

cards.title: Medford Data Lab
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Room 203
cards.notes: Work here when your assignment needs data or GIS software; the Medford lab provides workstations and in-person assistant support during library hours.
cards.short_summary: A research-computing space for data, GIS, and analysis work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Medford Data Lab is in Tisch Room 203, has computing-lab access during Tisch hours, and provides data and GIS support.
cards.source_title: Locations & Hours – Data Lab at Tufts
cards.access_notes: The Computing Lab is open whenever Tisch Library is open; verify current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Digital Design Studio
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Level 3, Room 303
cards.notes: Bring a digital or multimedia project to a workstation or modular table; the studio supports design work alongside individual laptop-based work.
cards.short_summary: A Level 3 creative workspace with design technology and flexible tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch’s Digital Design Studio is on the third floor and has 16 computers with design software plus modular tables for offline or laptop work.
cards.source_title: Top Five Underutilized Library Study Spaces for Finals | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: DDS computers and study space are available whenever Tisch Library is open; staffed services have separate hours.

cards.title: Lilly Music Library Study Carrel 1A
cards.subtitle: Granoff Music Center, lower level
cards.notes: Use Carrel 1A for a straightforward individual study setup near Lilly’s music collections; the library lists it as study space without audio equipment.
cards.short_summary: A named individual carrel in the music library.
cards.evidence_claim: Lilly Music Library identifies Study Carrel 1A as study space only, without equipment.
cards.access_notes: Lilly Music Library is in Granoff Music Center, Room M030; check its current hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ginn Library Third Floor Stacks Silent Study Area
cards.title: Ginn Third Floor Stacks
cards.subtitle: Ginn Library, Mugar Hall
cards.notes: Head to the Third Floor Stacks for independent, silent work; keep phones silent and move calls elsewhere, as Ginn’s rules specify.
cards.short_summary: Ginn’s designated silent-study area among the third-floor stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Ginn Library designates its Third Floor Stacks as a silent-study area for silent, independent study only.
cards.source_title: Studying in the Library | Ginn Library
cards.access_notes: No food; covered drinks are permitted. Keep cell phones silent and do not make voice calls.

cards.title: Joyce Cummings Center
cards.subtitle: 177 College Avenue, Medford
cards.notes: Use the building’s study spaces between classes and confirm access before you go; it also includes computer labs, printing, kitchenettes, and accessible bathrooms.
cards.short_summary: An academic building with study spaces and practical workday amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts states that the Joyce Cummings Center houses academic departments, research laboratories, study spaces, computer labs, and a JumboPrint station.
cards.access_notes: Semester building access is generally Mon–Thu 8am–1am, Fri 8am–8pm, and weekends 10am–8pm or 1am; hours can vary.
